escalations.text: "Devon Park: First Light" (Atelier 9 Gallery, Thu 10/29) lists "Suggested donation $10", which the rules put outside what I can book without asking. It was independently unbookable this week anyway — 10/29 is your BOS->JFK travel day — but if you want suggested-donation events treated as free in future weeks, tell me and I will include them.

"The Next Ten Years of Machine Learning" with Prof. Theo Marchetti (NYU Center for Data Science, Fri 10/30, 6:00-7:30 PM, free with registration) falls on a day you are in New York, and his bio supports tier 3 (NYU CS professor, ACM Fellow, former head of a major industry AI lab). The rules say to ask rather than book a famous speaker while you are away from home, so I did not register. Want me to book it? Note your AI slot is already filled by the 10/28 Vasquez lecture in Boston.
